subject: Re: FSQ kickoff — simplifying the tokenizer stack
body:
Hi Zofia,

Staffing: Leilani 70% (tokenizer integration), Carmen 50% (MaskGIT and UViM repro), Saoirse 40% (training infra).

Compute: repro fits inside our existing titan allocation, but the Q3 comparison sweeps — FSQ vs VQ at matched codebook sizes across three downstream tasks — need dedicated budget. Idris has verbally earmarked $180k from Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-36 for this project, which covers the sweeps with roughly 15% margin. Planning against that figure now; paperwork lands when Q3 opens.

Flag: UViM panoptic segmentation is the heaviest of the dense-prediction tasks; if anything slips it will be that.

Santiago
